packet.title: Schema document reader and assembly (implementation)
packet.summary: Reads schema documents into components and assembles them: XML representation rules, conditional inclusion, include, import, redefine and override through the resolver, QName resolution and circularity checks, without recursion.

body.p: After . Owns src/schema.c (the sxml_schema quintet and the find functions), src/schema_read.c, src/schema_assemble.c, src/schema_resolve.c, new src/schema_text.c (the text form of ), tests/schema_read_test.c, tests/schema_test.c. Schema documents through the XML parser into arena trees (; the reader walks a tree, as src/xslt_read.c walks a stylesheet), XML representation rules of every xs: element and attribute (src-element, src-attribute, src-ct, src-simple-type, ...), the annotations skipped, conditional inclusion (vc:, Part 1, 4.2.2), xs:include (chameleon included documents), xs:import, xs:redefine, xs:override (4.2.3 to 4.2.5) through the resolver with documents read once, QName resolution to components (src-resolve, the symbol spaces), circularity of groups, attribute groups and derivation, the schema defaults (elementFormDefault, attributeFormDefault, blockDefault, finalDefault, defaultAttributes, xpathDefaultNamespace). No C recursion: nested particles and groups use explicit stacks. Done when every schema document of the suite reads without a crash, leak or limit, and the in-scope schema tests pass ≥ 85% under the 5.3 driver (most expect a valid schema; the component constraints of 5.5 and 5.6 raise the rest). Golden: src/xslt_read.c, src/xquery_module.c (resolution, read once). Done 2026-10-18 (): one table of schema element roles (the schema for schema documents' attributes and child slots, the component each is read into), a walk without recursion, conditional inclusion, the assembly (read once, chameleon inclusion, redefine and override last and innermost first, the xml: namespace known), RESOLVE (references, base, item and member types, substitution groups, cycles), the text form with content models, sxml-xsd-test compiling schemas; schema tests 15,163 of 15,329 (98.9 %), slice 110. Not done: src-redefine 6.2.2 and 7.2.2.
